### Avance por Ítem de Obra

```{r}
# Datos de avance por ítem
items_obra <- data.frame(
  item = c("1 PROVISIÓN DE MATERIALES",
           "2 EXCAVACIÓN DE ZANJAS",
           "3 ACARREO Y COLOCACIÓN",
           "4 RELLENO DE ZANJA",
           "5 ROTURA Y REPOSICIÓN DE PAVIMENTOS",
           "6 NUDOS, EMPALMES Y CÁMARAS",
           "7 CRUCES",
           "8 ESTACIÓN DE BOMBEO SEGUNDO SOMBRA",
           "9 RESERVA LOS BARRANCOS 1",
           "10 SISTEMA DE ALIMENTACIÓN ELÉCTRICA Y CONTROL",
           "11 OTROS GASTOS"),
  planificado = c(4.07, 2.33, 0.80, 5.03, 4.24, 9.76, 3.38, 17.98, 24.40, 25.79, 2.23),
  ejecutado = c(2.00, 1.15, 0.40, 2.50, 2.10, 4.85, 1.70, 9.00, 12.20, 12.90, 1.20)
) %>%
  mutate(
    desvio = ejecutado - planificado,
    item_corto = substr(item, 1, 3)
  )

# Crear gráfico de barras agrupadas
plot_ly(items_obra) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = ~planificado,
    y = ~factor(item, levels = rev(item)),
    type = 'bar',
    orientation = 'h',
    name = 'Planificado',
    marker = list(color = '#3498DB'),
    text = ~paste0(planificado, '%'),
    textposition = 'outside',
    hovertemplate = paste(
      '<b>%{y}</b><br>',
      'Planificado: %{x:.2f}%<br>',
      '<extra></extra>'
    )
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    x = ~ejecutado,
    y = ~factor(item, levels = rev(item)),
    type = 'bar',
    orientation = 'h',
    name = 'Ejecutado',
    marker = list(color = '#27AE60'),
    text = ~paste0(ejecutado, '%'),
    textposition = 'outside',
    hovertemplate = paste(
      '<b>%{y}</b><br>',
      'Ejecutado: %{x:.2f}%<br>',
      '<extra></extra>'
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = '<b>Avance por Ítem de Obra - Planificado vs Ejecutado</b>',
      font = list(size = 16, family = 'Arial')
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = '<b>Porcentaje (%)</b>',
      titlefont = list(size = 12),
      gridcolor = '#ECF0F1',
      showgrid = TRUE,
      range = c(0, 30)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = '',
      tickfont = list(size = 10)
    ),
    barmode = 'group',
    plot_bgcolor = '#FAFAFA',
    paper_bgcolor = 'white',
    legend = list(
      orientation = 'h',
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center',
      y = -0.15
    ),
    margin = list(l = 250, r = 80, t = 60, b = 80),
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = 'white',
      font = list(size = 11)
    )
  ) %>%
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

### Zona de Obra - Traza de Impulsión

```{r}
datos_ruta <- read_excel("datos_ruta.xlsx") 
punto_inicio <- datos_ruta[1, ]
punto_final <- datos_ruta[nrow(datos_ruta), ] 

leaflet(data = datos_ruta) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addPolylines(
    lng = ~Longitud, 
    lat = ~Latitud,
    color = "#E74C3C",
    weight = 5,
    opacity = 0.9,
    label = "Traza de Impulsión"
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = punto_inicio,
    lng = ~Longitud, 
    lat = ~Latitud,
    radius = 8,
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    fillColor = "#27AE60",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    weight = 3,
    label = "Inicio: Reserva Segundo Sombra",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "12px")
    )
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = punto_final,
    lng = ~Longitud, 
    lat = ~Latitud,
    radius = 8,
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    fillColor = "#3498DB",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    weight = 3,
    label = "Final: Reserva Los Barrancos I",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "12px")
    )
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addMeasure(
    position = "topleft",
    primaryLengthUnit = "meters",
    primaryAreaUnit = "hectares"
  )
```

### Curva de Inversiones

```{r}
datos_plan <- data.frame(
  dias = c(0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300),
  avance = c(0, 0.0020, 0.0183, 0.0834, 0.1800, 0.2902, 0.3755, 0.5479, 0.6906, 0.8709, 1.0000),
  avance_mensual = c(0, 0.20, 1.63, 6.51, 9.66, 11.02, 8.53, 17.24, 14.27, 18.03, 12.91)
) %>%
  mutate(acumulado = percent(avance, accuracy = 0.01))

datos_real <- data.frame(
  dias = c(0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150),
  avance = c(0, 0.0025, 0.0200, 0.0900, 0.1950, 0.5000),
  avance_mensual = c(0, 0.25, 1.75, 7.00, 10.50, 30.50)
) %>%
  mutate(acumulado = percent(avance, accuracy = 0.01))

datos_comparados <- datos_real %>%
  left_join(select(datos_plan, dias, avance_plan = avance), by = "dias") %>%
  mutate(
    desvio = (avance - avance_plan) * 100,
    desvio_label = sprintf("%.2f%%", desvio),
    color = case_when(
      desvio > 0 ~ "#27AE60",
      desvio < 0 ~ "#E74C3C",
      TRUE ~ "#3498DB"
    ),
    customdata = Map(c,
                     sprintf("%.2f", avance_mensual),
                     acumulado,
                     desvio_label)
  )

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(
    data = datos_plan,
    x = ~dias,
    y = ~avance,
    type = 'scatter',
    mode = 'lines+markers',
    name = 'Planificado',
    line = list(color = '#E74C3C', width = 3),
    marker = list(color = '#E74C3C', size = 8, symbol = 'circle'),
    customdata = Map(c,
                     sprintf("%.2f", datos_plan$avance_mensual),
                     datos_plan$acumulado),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Planificado</b><br>",
      "Día: %{x}<br>",
      "Avance mensual: %{customdata[0]}%<br>",
      "Avance acumulado: %{customdata[1]}<br>",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    data = datos_comparados,
    x = ~dias,
    y = ~avance,
    type = 'scatter',
    mode = 'lines+markers',
    name = 'Real',
    line = list(color = '#3498DB', width = 3, dash = 'solid'),
    marker = list(size = 10, symbol = 'diamond', color = ~color, 
                  line = list(color = '#FFFFFF', width = 2)),
    customdata = datos_comparados$customdata,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Real</b><br>",
      "Día: %{x}<br>",
      "Avance mensual: %{customdata[0]}%<br>",
      "Avance acumulado: %{customdata[1]}<br>",
      "Desvío: %{customdata[2]}<br>",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>CURVA DE INVERSIONES - PLANIFICADO vs REAL</b>",
      font = list(size = 18, color = '#2C3E50', family = 'Arial'),
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center'
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Días de Proyecto</b>",
      titlefont = list(size = 14, color = '#2C3E50'),
      dtick = 30,
      range = c(-5, 305),
      gridcolor = '#ECF0F1',
      showgrid = TRUE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Avance Acumulado</b>",
      titlefont = list(size = 14, color = '#2C3E50'),
      tickformat = ".0%",
      range = c(0, 1.05),
      gridcolor = '#ECF0F1',
      showgrid = TRUE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    plot_bgcolor = '#FAFAFA',
    paper_bgcolor = 'white',
    legend = list(
      orientation = 'h',
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center',
      y = -0.15,
      bgcolor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
      bordercolor = '#BDC3C7',
      borderwidth = 1
    ),
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = 'white', 
      font = list(size = 12, family = 'Arial'),
      bordercolor = '#BDC3C7'
    ),
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 80, l = 80, r = 40)
  ) %>%
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('pan2d', 'lasso2d'))
```
